annotations.title: Take a post scheduled elsewhere off

description: Takes one post off the list of posts scheduled outside Marsell, by its id from scheduled_posts_read, when it was called off. It stays on file as cancelled. A post that already went out stays.

id.description: The post's id from scheduled_posts_read (el- and a uuid).

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
